title: Exclusive Internship DM
scenario: A LinkedIn recruiter says you were chosen for an internship but applications close tonight.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Exclusive Internship DM: the trap is to move you from a trusted channel to a fake page. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Scarcity pressure is a recruitment red flag.
